panel.title: Control device
panel.intro: Which device should drive the Pit Box interface?
panel.empty: Press a button on your gamepad or wheel for it to show up here.
panel.readyStandard: Works without calibration: this device reports a standard layout, which Pit Box can read.
panel.readyOverride: Works without calibration: Pit Box ships a profile for this model.
panel.needsCalibration: Needs calibration: without a profile, this device drives nothing.
panel.unknownHelp: Pit Box does not know this model yet. Wheels follow no standard for their D-pad: with no reference, Pit Box cannot guess which button does what. Calibration takes two minutes and makes the wheel usable right away. You can then send the resulting profile to the author in one click.

calib.title: Calibration
calib.rest: Do not touch anything for two seconds.
calib.duplicate: This input is already used for “{dir}”. Try again.
calib.timeout: Nothing detected. Many wheels have no D-pad: skipping this step is perfectly normal.
calib.optional: Optional: skip it if your device has no spare button.
calib.scrollHint: Optional: push down the axis you want to scroll lists with — the right stick on a gamepad.
calib.tryIt: Try it: the highlight should move.
calib.share: The profile holds the device model and its button indices — nothing that identifies you.

settings.enabledHint: Master switch: unchecked, no device drives the interface. The choices below are kept. Takes effect immediately, no need to click Save.

settings.title: Settings
settings.tabGeneralHint: Language, interface scaling, default 3D preview showroom.
settings.tabPathsHint: Environment configuration. Library, overlay, and rules are separate stores.
settings.tabImportHint: App behavior when importing a mod.
settings.tabPreviewHint: 3D preview shown on a car sheet. Changes apply right away.
settings.preview3dEnabled: Show the 3D preview on car sheets
settings.preview3dEnabledHint: Unchecked, car sheets show the skin photo instead. The toggle on the sheet does the same thing.

preview3dSlider.zoomHint: How large the car sits in the frame. The mouse wheel does the same, for one visit.
preview3dSlider.azimuthHint: Which side the car shows when the turntable stops. 0° is head-on, 90° is side-on.
preview3dSlider.elevationHint: The steeper the pitch, the more the view looks down on the car — and the more the nose can leave the frame as it turns.
preview3dSlider.heightHint: Raises or lowers the car in the frame, without changing the angle it is seen from.
preview3dSlider.fovHint: A short focal length comes close and dramatises, a long one flattens and flatters. The car keeps its size in the frame.
preview3dSlider.spinHint: At 0% the car no longer turns on its own; it still responds to the mouse.
preview3dSlider.exposureHint: Brightens or darkens everything. Useful on mods whose textures come out dark.
preview3dSlider.lightHint: Power of the studio strips. Past 100 %, the highlights on the bodywork lean in.
preview3dSlider.reflectionHint: The car reflects underneath itself. At 0 %, the floor goes matte again.
preview3dSlider.reflectionBlurHint: Sharp, the floor looks wet; blurred, it looks lacquered.
preview3dSlider.reflectionReachHint: How far the reflection spreads before it dies out.
preview3dSlider.poolHint: Pale halo painted under the car. The reflection largely stands in for it, so it can come down.
preview3dSlider.shadowHint: Density of the shadow projected under the car.

preview3dQualityOption.standardHint: The lightest. Pick it if the preview stutters.
preview3dQualityOption.highHint: The default: clean edges, well within reach of a gaming graphics card.

preview3dIntroOption.noneHint: The car turns at its set speed straight away.
preview3dIntroOption.rampHint: The car eases up to its set speed.
preview3dIntroOption.launchHint: The car sets off fast, then slows to its set speed.

settings.preview3dCacheHint: Past it, the least visited previews are deleted, and rebuilt on the next visit.
settings.languageHint: Takes effect right away; the choice is saved when you click Save.
settings.zoomHint: Useful on a high-resolution screen if Windows scaling isn't picked up by the app. Takes effect right away; saved when you click Save.
settings.bigpictureZoomHint: Extra zoom applied only in Big Picture mode (fullscreen) — handy for reading the interface from a distance, controller in hand.
settings.showroomSceneHint: Showroom loaded by acShowroom when you click "3D preview" on a car sheet, among those installed in Assetto Corsa. The white studio loads almost instantly and without music; the other showrooms weigh several hundred MB.
settings.resourceExtractionHint: On import, files outside game content (PDFs, changelogs, skin templates, presentation images…) never end up in the junctioned folder. This setting decides whether they're kept in the mod's resources folder or dropped — never a question on every import. "Information only" (default) keeps light files (txt/pdf/images); "Everything" also captures templates, archives and 3D sources.
settings.keepSourceArchiveHint: Keeps a copy of each mod's original archive (or folder) alongside the extracted content in the library. Makes the "Reinstall from source archive" action available on the mod's sheet, useful after corruption or an accidental change. Off by default (extra disk space); only applies to imports made after it's turned on.
settings.deployHardlinkHint: Zero copying, no admin rights needed. Requirement: Assetto Corsa and the library must be on the same drive — otherwise it silently falls back to physical copies (double disk usage).
settings.deploySymlinkHint: Works across any drive. Requirement: Windows Developer Mode must be enabled, or the app launched as administrator (not recommended).
settings.devModeTooltip:
Windows 11: Settings → Privacy & security → For developers → Developer Mode.
Windows 10: Settings → Update & Security → For developers → Developer Mode.
Click to open this page directly.
settings.unsavedPrompt: Some settings were changed (and already applied as a live preview, e.g. zoom/language) but not saved. Save, or discard and revert?

music.enable: Enable music in Big Picture mode
music.useCustomFoldersHint: Unchecked: the two built-in default ambiences are used, nothing to configure.

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.intro: Pit Box needs to know its environment before it can start. The paths below were auto-detected where possible — check them, then finish.

maintenance.subtitle: Detects broken mods (missing files) and orphan junctions. Nothing is deleted without your action.
maintenance.stockHint: Indexes the base cars/tracks present in content/ — read-only, cannot be deactivated. Lets skins and sounds attach to them.
maintenance.stockReset: Also reset my edits on this content
maintenance.stockResetPrompt:
The names, descriptions, manual tags and favourites you entered on the base content will be erased and replaced by whatever the game's files say. This cannot be undone.

Your imported mods are not affected.
maintenance.stockNoneNew: No new base content to index.
maintenance.reindexHint: Re-reads the name, author, tags, and features of every already-imported mod from its files, and reapplies the rules. Useful after manually editing a mod's file, or after an app fix affecting how files are read — without having to reimport.
maintenance.recalcSize: Recalculate each mod's disk size (can be slow)
maintenance.clean: No issue detected. Library and junctions are consistent.
maintenance.brokenHint: Active version files not found or invalid structure. Deleting removes the mod from the overlay and its library files.
maintenance.orphanSubsTitle: Skins and sounds without a mod
maintenance.orphanSubsHint: Their car or track was deleted. They are kept in case you reinstall it: reimporting the same mod finds them again as they were.
maintenance.orphansHint: Links in content/ pointing to a deleted version. Removing them only touches the link (guard rail: never a real folder).
maintenance.emptyHint: Run a scan to detect issues.
maintenance.repairHint: Redeploys active mods and recreates missing or broken skin projections — useful after a library copy (e.g. robocopy) that doesn't preserve junctions, or to catch up with a Pit Box update. Never touches stored files.
maintenance.repairReinstallOption: Also reinstall from the source archive any broken mods that have one kept
maintenance.repairReinstalledDone: {count} mod(s) reinstalled from their source archive.

rules.title: Tag rules
rules.subtitle: Editable ontology — applied non-destructively. The mod's file is never modified.
rules.tagMergeHint: Synonyms → canonical tag(s). Comma-separated values. A tag
rules.trackCategoriesHint: Allowed categories, in priority order (1st = primary). A track takes the ones among its tags that appear here. Reorder with ↑/↓.
rules.brandFixHint: If the name contains X → force the brand.
rules.nameToTagHint: If the name contains X → add tag(s).
rules.classFixHint: The ui's "class" value → race/street class + derived tags.
rules.specsExtractionHint: Technical tag → structured field. The tag is removed from the vocabulary.
rules.countryExtractionHint: Country tag → "country" field (if empty). The tag is removed from the vocabulary.
rules.impactText: mod(s) would be affected by these rules

profiles.subtitle: Named sets of active mods — cars, tracks, Other mods and Apps. Applying a profile reconciles everything to match the set exactly.
profiles.captureHint: The profile remembers everything currently active: mods (with their version), Other mods and Apps.
profiles.empty: No profile. Activate mods, then capture the state above.

transversal.bundledHint: Part of the mod's initial content — not individually removable, only the whole mod.

apps.emptyHint: Import an app via general import (folder {path}).
apps.confirmDelete: Delete app "{id}"? It will be deactivated and its files removed.
apps.openFolderTooltip: Open the app's folder in Explorer

others.subtitle: Mods of an unrecognized type (shaders, CSP configs, UI mods…) — never lost. Activated by junction like other types, or by file link for a plain addition into an already-existing folder (never replacing an existing file). If two "other mods" contest the same spot, the mod marked priority wins on its next activation.
others.emptyHint: A mod whose type isn't recognized by any import (car, track, skin, sound, app) lands here automatically.
others.priorityTooltip: Mark as priority: wins in case of a contested spot
others.confirmDelete: Delete "{id}"? It will be deactivated (junctions removed) and its files erased.
others.managedTooltip: Content Manager syncs these folders from the CSP config repository. It may replace these files with its own versions at any time. This is not the recommended location for a mod.

import.subtitlePrefix: Adds mods to the library. An imported (or updated) mod is
import.subtitleSuffix: — no separate step needed to drive it.
import.archiveHint: The common case: a .zip, .rar, or .7z file downloaded as-is. The app extracts it, detects the type (car, track, skin, sound…), and files it into the library.
import.folderHint: For a mod you've already extracted yourself, without going back through the original archive.
import.moveHintSuffix: empties the source folder — faster if it's on the same drive as the library (simple rename), otherwise falls back to a copy followed by a delete.
import.massHintPrefix: To migrate an entire catalog at once — for example a mods/ folder from Mod Organizer 2, where
import.massHintBold1: each top-level subfolder is a mod
import.massHintMid: . The app first analyzes everything without writing anything (new, updates, duplicates, ambiguous cases), you arbitrate the ambiguous cases
import.massHintSuffix: , then the import runs — it can resume if interrupted.
import.dndHint: The quick gesture: drop an archive anywhere in the window, on any screen — the import starts immediately, using the copy/move mode chosen above for a folder.

importOverlay.extensionNote: layer added ({added} added, {overwritten} overwritten) — base untouched
importOverlay.ambiguousBody: "{name}" targets existing content: {added} files added, {overwritten} overwritten out of {total} total. Is this an update (replaces the base) or an extension (added on top, replaces nothing)?
importOverlay.optionalNote: Shipped separately by the author, and they replace base game files.
importOverlay.modalBodyMid: " looks like a mod already present (different folder:
importOverlay.pendingNote: Neither game content nor documentation: the call is yours. Nothing is installed until you choose.
importOverlay.pendingActionGameHint: Placed elsewhere in the Assetto Corsa install, alongside the mod's other game additions. Removed when the mod is disabled.
importOverlay.pendingActionLayerHint: Composed over the mod's version without ever changing it. Removed from « Layers & extensions » on the mod page.
importOverlay.pendingActionResourcesHint: Filed with the mod's documentation, readable from its page. Installs nothing: your Assetto Corsa folder is left untouched.
importOverlay.pendingActionOtherHint: Filed as a standalone mod, enable it whenever you like.
importOverlay.pendingActionDiscardHint: Deleted from the library. The import journal keeps a record of it.
importOverlay.pendingReplacesWhy: These files apply to every session, not just to this mod. The originals are backed up and restored if you remove the addition.
importOverlay.pendingNoSuggestion: No answer is better up front — this one is yours to make.
importOverlay.pendingNoticeUnreadable: {name} — open the folder to read it.
importOverlay.unmanagedNote: a mod installed outside Pit Box occupies this folder — nothing was changed. Delete it from the game, then import again

about.title: About
about.philosophy: Pit Box organizes your mod collection without ever touching creators' original files: your cars and tracks stay strictly identical to what their authors published — the app adds a layer of metadata alongside, never inside.
about.acDesc: Racing simulation published by Kunos Simulazioni. Pit Box is a hobby project, independent and not affiliated with Kunos Simulazioni.
about.cmDesc: Launch and graphics-config (CSP) engine. Pit Box drives Content Manager but doesn't replace it — it must be installed for the app to work. Independent project, not affiliated.
about.qbDesc: Used for standalone mod export (acd.bms script extraction). Not bundled — path configured by the user. Free software, GPL 2.0 license.
about.musicMenuDesc: Default menu music ambience (Big Picture mode). Pixabay Content License — free to use, redistribution included.
about.musicGridDesc: Default session setup screen music ambience (Big Picture mode). Pixabay Content License — free to use, redistribution included.
about.ossToggle: Pit Box is built with {count} open source libraries
about.ossGenerated: List generated automatically from Cargo.toml and package.json · {date}
about.legal: Pit Box is an independent hobby project, not affiliated with Kunos Simulazioni, the Content Manager team, or any other publisher mentioned above. Assetto Corsa is a registered trademark of Kunos Simulazioni S.r.l. All trademarks mentioned belong to their respective owners. Pit Box's source code is distributed under the GPL v3 license — free to use, modify and redistribute, provided any derivative version also stays under GPL v3.
about.madeWith: Made with ♥ for the AC community
